_comment: Copy this file to nextmove.config.json and fill in your own values. Secrets do NOT go here — use the environment (NEXTMOVE_IMAP_PASSWORD / NOTION_TOKEN) or a local secrets.json (git-ignored).

policy._note_title_template: Used only by the mechanical fallback (suggest/apply --input). A judgment 'create' decision keeps the agent's title exactly as written.
policy._note_dedupe: Tiered dedupe. 'mode': 'tiered' (default) uses the three ratios below; 'exact' keeps the old binary dedupe (identity key or identical title only). refresh_ratio: at or above it, the candidate is the same row. hold_ratio: at or above it but below refresh_ratio, the candidate is HELD for a human — nothing is created, nothing is overwritten. project_floor: when the customer has exactly one row and the score reaches this, treat it as the same row.
policy._note_protect_human_edits: When true (default), a task row the human edited after this tool's last write is never flipped to done — it is reported as 'protected' instead. Set false only if you want the tool to win over manual edits.
